source.quote_free_summary: A competitor under the legal age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who has written parental permission to act as guardian and who is responsible for the minor's safety and conduct.

requirement: Competition OS does not capture, verify or manage guardian accompaniment or written guardian permission. Until the Option A design (docs/competition/od02-option-a-minors-design.md) is built and approved, no under-18 competitor may be registered, so the situation this rule governs cannot arise through Competition OS.
enforcement_point: Server: POST /api/events/[slug]/competition/checkout evaluates every entry participant before any database call. The rule itself (accompaniment) is not implemented.

tests.name: refuses an under-18 competitor, including in Studio/Custom style drafts (no event-type exemption)

interpretation_notes: Owner decision OD-02 (2026-11-23): Option C for first activation (prohibit under-18), Option A as the future design. The accompaniment requirement is therefore AVOIDED, not implemented; status stays unsupported so it is not mistaken for compliance with the guardian-accompaniment rule. The clause was re-read in the pinned PDF (SHA-256 matches the registry). Whether a jurisdiction's legal age differs from 18 is NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE.
